messages:
ana: Running async e2e against Dedicated through our corporate HTTP proxy and hitting cert verify failures. Sync workaround (REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE) worked locally but async still fails. Anyone seen this?

ben: Share error + how you create the async client. aiohttp needs SSLContext in the connector usually.

ana: Error: ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] unable to get local issuer certificate. Client init: AsyncRedwoodClient(api_key=..., base_url='https://dedicated.prod', verify='/etc/ssl/certs/company_ca.pem', proxies={'https':'http://proxy:3128'})

kai: Two things: (1) REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE is for requests only, aiohttp doesn't honor it. (2) For aiohttp you must pass a TCPConnector(ssl=SSLContext) or set SSL_CERT_FILE env var before process start.

ana: Confirmed: creating ssl.create_default_context(cafile='/etc/ssl/certs/company_ca.pem') and passing into TCPConnector fixed it. But our SDK doesn't expose a connector/ssl_context param for the async client.

ben: Repro steps + hackable workaround sound actionable. We should: A) document the env differences (REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE vs SSL_CERT_FILE), B) add sample showing TCPConnector/ssl_context for async quickstart, C) add SDK feature request to accept ca_bundle or ssl_context param on AsyncRedwoodClient.

kai: I filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/2022 "async: expose ssl_context/connector or ca_bundle path for aiohttp client (proxy + custom CA support)" with repro and sample code.

infra-bot: CI/infra note: short-term set SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/company_ca.pem in async test job containers. Created PR #1302 to update pipeline.

ana: Also observed bundled PEM ordering problems: some customers concat leaf before intermediates which confuses Python/OpenSSL in some versions. Adding a small normalize script to devex quickstarts to reorder chain (intermediates then root last) could save folks time.

ben: Good call. I'll add a doc task and a tiny script in the quickstarts repo. Also adding a checklist item to Dedicated onboarding: "verify proxy cert chain and test both curl and aiohttp with provided CA bundle".

kai: Note for security: if proxy does TLS interception, onboarding must record customer consent and we should surface security implications in private docs.

ana: Thanks all — will paste final async snippet into the issue and the PR for docs.
